mapper.select: SELECT P.pop_idx AS "popIdx", P.sys_se_cd AS "sysSeCd", P.pop_titl AS "popTitl", P.pop_cn AS "popCn", P.file_grp_id AS "fileGrpId", P.surv_id AS "survId", F.file_sn AS "fileSn", F.file_orgnl_nm AS "fileOrgnlNm" FROM TN_POP_M001 P LEFT JOIN TN_COM_F001 F ON P.file_grp_id = F.file_grp_id AND F.del_yn = 'N' WHERE P.sys_id = #{sysId} AND P.sys_se_cd = #{sysSeCd} AND P.use_yn = 'Y' AND P.del_yn = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN P.bgng_ymd AND P.end_ymd

SELECT P.pop_idx AS "popIdx", P.sys_id AS "sysId", P.sys_se_cd AS "sysSeCd", P.pop_titl AS "popTitl", P.pop_cn AS "popCn", P.bgng_ymd AS "bgngYmd", P.end_ymd AS "endYmd", P.use_yn AS "useYn", P.file_grp_id AS "fileGrpId", P.surv_id AS "survId", S.surv_nm AS "survNm" FROM TN_POP_M001 P LEFT JOIN TN_SURVEY_M001 S ON P.sys_id = S.sys_id AND P.surv_id = S.surv_id WHERE P.sys_id = #{sysId} AND P.pop_idx = #{popIdx} AND P.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TN_POP_M001 SET pop_titl = #{popTitl}, pop_cn = #{popCn}, bgng_ymd = #{bgngYmd}, end_ymd = #{endYmd}, use_yn = #{useYn}, file_grp_id = #{fileGrpId}, surv_id = #{survId}, sys_se_cd = #{sysSeCd}, last_mdfr_id = #{userId}, last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE pop_idx = #{popIdx}
UPDATE TN_POP_M001 SET del_yn = 'Y', last_mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE pop_idx = #{popIdx}
